trading_instruments_shape_check.name: trading_instruments_shape_check
trading_instruments_shape_check.value:
(
				"trading_instruments"."asset_class" = 'stocks'
				and "trading_instruments"."round_lot" > 0
				and "trading_instruments"."underlying_symbol" is null
				and "trading_instruments"."option_type" is null
				and "trading_instruments"."expiration_date" is null
				and "trading_instruments"."strike_price" is null
				and "trading_instruments"."contract_multiplier" is null
			) or (
				"trading_instruments"."asset_class" = 'options'
				and "trading_instruments"."underlying_symbol" is not null
				and "trading_instruments"."option_type" in ('call', 'put')
				and "trading_instruments"."exercise_style" in ('american', 'bermudan', 'european')
				and "trading_instruments"."expiration_date" is not null
				and "trading_instruments"."strike_price" >= 0
				and "trading_instruments"."contract_multiplier" > 0
			)

trading_orders_price_shape_check.name: trading_orders_price_shape_check

trading_orders_trailing_state_check.name: trading_orders_trailing_state_check
trading_orders_trailing_state_check.value: ("trading_orders"."trailing_watermark" is null and "trading_orders"."trailing_stop_price" is null) or ("trading_orders"."order_type" = 'trailing_stop' and "trading_orders"."trailing_watermark" > 0 and "trading_orders"."trailing_stop_price" > 0)

trading_portfolios_archive_check.name: trading_portfolios_archive_check
trading_portfolios_archive_check.value: ("trading_portfolios"."status" = 'active' and "trading_portfolios"."archived_at" is null) or ("trading_portfolios"."status" = 'archived' and "trading_portfolios"."archived_at" is not null)

trading_reservations_release_check.name: trading_reservations_release_check
trading_reservations_release_check.value: ("trading_reservations"."status" = 'active' and "trading_reservations"."released_at" is null) or ("trading_reservations"."status" <> 'active' and "trading_reservations"."released_at" is not null)
